resources.string: Turn on the switch below and Kizzy+ starts watching GameNative and Eden.
GameNative and Eden aren\'t on screen
Your status shows a game only while GameNative or Eden is the app on screen. Kizzy+ itself doesn\'t count, so you can check in here mid-game.
Kizzy+ uses this name every time it detects this game. Detected as: %1$s
No renamed games yet. While a game is showing at the top of this screen, use Rename this game.
Cleared. A game that\'s still on screen comes back within a few seconds.
Kizzy\'s %1$s is running too, and it sets its own status (such as \"Playing GameNative\") whatever Kizzy+ does. Clear my Discord status stops it, or turn it off in Kizzy.
Root access was not granted. Kizzy+ needs it to see GameNative\'s Wine processes and Eden\'s game list. Allow it in Magisk (or KernelSU), then tap the button below.
Not signed in. Pick one of the options below.
The Kizzy app sends presence with its own login, so Kizzy+ doesn\'t need one in this mode.
Couldn\'t find a login in Kizzy. Open Kizzy, sign in there, then try again.
Discord rejected that token. Sign in again.
Couldn\'t reach Discord to check the token: %1$s
Hand each game to the Kizzy app
Kizzy+ opens a Discord connection only while a game is running and the screen is on, then closes it.
Kizzy+ starts Kizzy\'s Custom RPC through root with the game\'s name and art, and stops it when you stop playing. This drives a part of Kizzy that isn\'t a public API, so a Kizzy update can break it.
How it looks on your profile
Show GameNative or Eden as the small icon and second line
The check lists what Kizzy+ sees: GameNative\'s Wine processes, its last launched game, Eden\'s running game, and the Discord connection. Your token is never included.
Discord attaches the artwork to this application. The default is the public ID Kizzy uses. You can create your own on the Discord Developer Portal and paste its ID here.
An application ID is a number with 17 to 20 digits.
Kizzy+ keeps only the login token, encrypted on this device, and clears the web session afterwards.
Shares your game while GameNative or Eden is on screen.
Paused while the screen is off
Your Discord status was cleared. It comes back when you unlock and keep playing.
